title: Florida House, District 15
what_it_does: Represents District 15 (Nassau, Part of Duval) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings.

candidates.name: Dean Black
candidates.occupation: State representative; business owner and cattle rancher; Air Force veteran
candidates.background: Dean Black, 60, is an eighth-generation Northeast Floridian, business owner and cattle rancher who served in the Air Force and Florida Air National Guard. He chaired the Republican Party of Duval County from 2018 to 2024, was elected to the House in 2022 and re-elected in 2024, and is vice chair of the House Select Committee on Property Taxes.

candidates.name: Lloyd Caulker
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Write-in candidate: the name is not printed on the ballot; voters must write it on the blank line
candidates.background: Lloyd Caulker is a Jacksonville entrepreneur and write-in candidate whose platform focuses on the maritime economy, biofuels and renewable fuels, education and workforce development. He also ran in 2024.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

guns.summary: His site says public safety, and gun control in particular, should be a top priority.
guns.quote: We need to create more living wage jobs, improve our schools, and make public safety, gun control in particular, a top priority.

sources.title: Lloyd Caulker campaign website: Platform

energy.summary: He advocates renewable fuels such as biodiesel and renewable natural gas and a cleaner, sustainable future.

sources.title: Lloyd Caulker campaign website: Platform

taxes.summary: He says he believes in lower taxes and small government.
taxes.quote: I believe in lower taxes, small government, affordable housing, accessible healthcare, quality education, and stronger support for our elderly.

candidates.name: Chadd Charland
candidates.occupation: Freelance arts and culture writer, podcaster and small-business owner
candidates.background: Chadd Charland, 51, of Fernandina Beach is a first-time candidate running without party affiliation. A writer, podcaster and small-business owner with a journalism degree from Auburn, he helped lead the push for a data-center moratorium in Nassau County and campaigns on the environment, public education and equal rights.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

education_choice.summary: Charland says public money should go to public schools only and calls vouchers 'welfare for wealthy people.'
education_choice.quote: I support public money for public schools only. Vouchers are welfare for wealthy people

sources.title: News4JAX 2026 Voter's Guide: Florida House District 15

growth.quote: I will challenge developers in an effort to slow sprawl and protect rural and natural Florida.
